dialogues.speaker: Hemaki
dialogues.text: Hey there, young 'un. Want to try some surfing? When this old dog was your age, I could battle waves a hundred meters high!

dialogues.speaker: Hemaki
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you can start from over yonder.

dialogues.speaker: Hemaki
dialogues.text: You're a dab hand at surfing, young'un. D'you fancy taking over my business?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, but I've got business elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Hemaki
dialogues.text: Ohoho, of course. If you change your mind, just come back whenever.
